responsibilities: Own and scale our data warehouse to support a fast-growing Go-To-Market and product ecosystem
Build and maintain ETL pipelines using dbt to integrate data from tools, apps, and third-party platforms
Design clean, reusable data models that power reporting across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance
Create dashboards and analysis that uncover trends in revenue, product usage, and customer behavior
Set up data quality checks and alerts to ensure accurate, timely, and trustworthy data
Support planning and forecasting by partnering with teams to define KPIs and build forward-looking models

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Strong product and business sense — you know how to balance technical purity with speed, scalability, and impact
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Mixed: quality signals ('data quality checks and alerts', 'clean, reusable data models', 'data modeling best practices') sit against an equal number of speed signals, including an explicit instruction to 'balance technical purity with speed'.
evidence.domain_risk: Design clean, reusable data models that power reporting across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: despite Peregrine's public-safety customers, this role owns the internal analytics stack for GTM, product and finance reporting, with no regulatory, audit or external-facing consequence named.
evidence.data_team_maturity: you'll play a foundational role in shaping how data is modeled, accessed, and used across the company
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Early: one person owns 'the architecture and execution of our internal analytics stack' in a 'foundational role', with no other data roles or existing data team mentioned.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain ETL pipelines using dbt to integrate data from tools, apps, and third-party platforms
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring manager: the bullets name the tool and the actual job — 'ETL pipelines using dbt to integrate data from tools, apps, and third-party platforms' and 'Set up data quality checks and alerts'.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: partnering closely with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to turn raw data into insight and insight into action
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed: commercial, product and finance audiences are named together twice with no hierarchy — 'reporting across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance'.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will own the architecture and execution of our internal analytics stack
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic: the role owns architecture outright and sets the measures — 'work directly with leaders across the business to define KPIs' — in a 'foundational role'.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: AI appears only in the company description ('Our AI-enabled platform'); no responsibility or requirement asks the candidate to use or build for AI.
evidence.testing_framing: Set up data quality checks and alerts to ensure accurate, timely, and trustworthy data
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: data quality checks and alerting are a named responsibility the candidate builds, not a testing tool listed under requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Set up data quality checks and alerts to ensure accurate, timely, and trustworthy data
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: trustworthy data appears once, as the fifth of six bullets, in a JD otherwise framed around building the stack and surfacing insight.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: you'll play a foundational role in shaping how data is modeled, accessed, and used across the company
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Greenfield: every responsibility is a build — 'Own and scale our data warehouse', 'Build and maintain ETL pipelines', 'Design clean, reusable data models', 'Set up data quality checks' — in a foundational role.
evidence.work_arrangement: Located in New York, NY and willing to work in office four days a week
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is one operational bullet: 'Set up data quality checks and alerts to ensure accurate, timely, and trustworthy data.'
